div.div:
Login + Token Lifecycle
1. Compare password with Argon2id
2. Issue HS256 access JWT: 1 hour
3. Store opaque refresh token: 60 days
4. Refresh: unexpired + not revoked
5. Revoke: set revoked_at timestamp
Logout clears browser session
